CM Yogi Adityanath Criticizes Opposition on Waqf Properties and Babri

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has strongly criticized opposition parties, specifically the Samajwadi Party and Congress. He accused them of changing their stance rapidly, comparing them to chameleons. Adityanath also linked their past actions to support for Waqf properties and the Babri Masjid, questioning their current positions.
